entries.353b04e450db0925: Consolidated subsidiaries Nihon Double Reed Co., Ltd. and Ruboa Co., Ltd. import, sell and repair musical instruments. It operates specialty stores for double-reed instruments, centred on European-made instruments, and provides adjustment by specialist technical staff, regular maintenance after purchase and repair of malfunctions. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥661 million.
entries.48c14960bb09496f: A company that mainly sells Honda vehicles, and also handles specialty sales of double-reed instruments and real estate leasing.
entries.7507ccbdad3fecef: Musical instrument buyers, including junior high school students in school wind band clubs
entries.8758f6b18ecbf5b4: Automobile users requesting vehicle inspections, maintenance and repairs
entries.aab64192e8b581fc: The company leases land, buildings and parking lots it owns in Saitama and Gunma prefectures (including store leasing to consolidated subsidiaries). In addition to continuing redevelopment of existing properties in Honjo City, it newly acquired land and buildings in Iruma City, Saitama Prefecture, in October 2025. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥434 million.
entries.fefb40f0501297ee: Consolidated subsidiary Honda New Saitama Co., Ltd. sells and maintains Honda vehicles and sells insurance. Its sales efforts centre on the N-BOX and FREEDs, among others, and it also works to increase repair and inspection visits, including through a Web-based maintenance booking system. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,557 million, the core of the group as a whole.
